create_scannet_detection_dataset: create a ScannetDetectionDataset instance for train/val/test splits with configurable num_points and augmentation
get_scannet_detection_item: get a point cloud sample with bounding box labels and vote targets from the dataset by index
run_scannet_detection_dataset: run the ScannetDetectionDataset main block to export point clouds and votes as PLY files
viz_votes: visualize point votes and vote masks by writing object and voted point clouds to PLY files
viz_obb: visualize oriented bounding box ground truth by writing oriented boxes and centroids to PLY files
